node.title: Budget-three rate-half list intersection reduction
node.statement: Any four distinct codewords listed at agreement 3n/4-1 in a rate-half RS code have, up to codeword relabeling, one of six incidence types and give a pairwise-distinct kernel vector of an explicit 4-wise RS intersection matrix with 3k columns. Full column rank on those six fixed-subgroup types would prove predecessor safety. An exact RS[F_17,mu_8,4] rank-11/12 witness realizes one type, so pairwise MDS and Johnson arithmetic alone cannot close B*=3. No official crossing is claimed.
